evidence.excerpt: Jointly training the encoder and diffusion reasoner with shared model weights encourages thought tokens to be both useful for the task and predictable from the available context.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Across eleven vision-language model (VLM) benchmarks and two vision-language-action (VLA) suites, Uni-LaDiR achieves relative gains over the strongest evaluated baselines of 7.3% on visual reasoning tasks and 6.1% on robot manipulation tasks.
